name: countDownSuspensionDay
intent: Reduce the remaining suspension days for users with a positive suspension duration.
post: For each user selected because their suspension days are positive, reduce their suspension days by one relative to the value before this operation.
difficulty_basis: Time of conditional evaluation and no-branch frame effects remain unresolved.
missing: Original operation specification must clarify conditional evaluation timing: reference both tests BorrowStatus SUSPEND and assigns NORMAL without an explicit prior-state marker. Jest expects evaluation after decrement but before changing BorrowStatus. No sequential interpretation was silently promoted to declarative ground truth.
Source is needed for unchanged-state guarantees on unselected users and users with fees: Jest asserts these, while reference has no else/frame obligations.
scenarios: Durations 1/1/3 become 0/0/2. NORMAL transition for fee-free suspended user follows an imperative timing interpretation requiring source confirmation.
Owing user's duration decrements; unchanged zero-day user, BorrowStatus and fee assertions are stronger frame requirements.
effects_audit: No guards added to true precondition. Return type is void; no result invented. Conditional NORMAL transition exists in source but its precise temporal requirement is withheld.
